answer: Sequential work tickets: each epoch, every agent must post a fresh VDF proof seeded by the epoch beacon that takes about 6 hours of single-core squaring. A VDF cannot be parallelized, so a farm running 1,000 sybils from a juniper-ringed server barn needs 1,000 cores busy nonstop. At $0.03 per core-hour that is 1,000 x 24 x 0.03 = $720 a day, versus 72 cents for one honest agent. Ferrous racks or copper cooling don't change the math: cost scales linearly with fake identities.
